3693-4659-5224-5645.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {1} due to Stenn, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Walking Ballista, adding {C}{C}.
When Walking Ballista dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-4693-8337.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-4693-8337.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size.
250-779-1479-4693-8337.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, M'Ress and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability
Resolve the M'Ress trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, M'Ress triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard Dakmor Salvage and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

2527-4076-4279-4549-5933.easyPrerequisites:
You control another nontoken Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard or Orc that has toughness 2 or more.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2527-4076-4279-4549-5933.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Burakos, adding one mana of any color.
Burakos triggers, causing it and other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the other Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard or Orc, targeting Burakos
When the creature dies, the creature's undying ability and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Burakos and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing Burakos, targeting the other creature.
When Burakos dies, its undying ability and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning Burakos from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the other creature and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

6-4091-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Vitalize is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Aphetto Alchemist doesn't have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
6-4091-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Vitalize without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Vitalize, untapping all creatures you control
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

997-1981-2415-7286.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, South Wind Avatar and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, scrying 1.
Repeat.

4222-6723-7938.description:
Activate Shuttle Ace by tapping it, adding {U}.
Shuttle Ace triggers, causing you to gain 2 life
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Shuttle Ace.
Repeat.

2034-3490-6783-7920.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
2034-3490-6783-7920.description:
Activate Junk Golem by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Tresserhorn's Lord triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

4050-7286-7498-7541.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least 5 life.
Grave Researcher is prepared.
4050-7286-7498-7541.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Biblioplex Tomekeeper, adding {B}.
South Wind Avatar's first triggered ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
South Wind Avatar's last ability triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast the copy of Reanimate from exile by paying {B}, returning Biblioplex Tomekeeper from your graveyard to the battlefield and losing 4 life.
When Biblioplex Tomekeeper enters, it triggers, preparing Grave Researcher.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2012-3967-6972.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Strangleroot Geist
When Strangleroot Geist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Strangleroot Geist
When Strangleroot Geist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Strangleroot Geist enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
2012-3967-6972.notes: If Strangleroot Geist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

uses.n: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness

575-4294-6798-7115.description:
Cast Etali by paying {5}{R}{R}
When Etali enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Etali.
When Etali dies, Yedora triggers, returning Etali from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Holding priority, activate Etali by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Etali trigger from step 2, exiling cards from the top of each library until each player has exiled a nonland card, and causing you to cast any number of those cards without paying its mana cost.
For each card cast, Toph's second ability triggers once.
Resolve the first Toph trigger, earthbending Etali.
Resolve any remaining triggers, earthbending any other lands you desire. If you do not want to earthbend other lands, target Etali with all remaining triggers.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Etali.
When Etali dies, Toph and Yedora trigger.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, choosing not to return Etali.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Etali from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Umbral Collar Zealot abilities from step 11.

1558-2638-3129-3257-4231.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-2638-3129-3257-4231.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Primal Vigor.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2730-5256-5987.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity.
When Angel of Indemnity dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Angel of Indemnity
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

5147-5702-7084.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

2342-2906-7070.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
2342-2906-7070.description:
Activate Shaman en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Shaman en-Kor.
The Shaman en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Shaman en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Rakdos.
Repeat.

3293-5412-5531.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
You do not have any static effects boosting your creatures' toughness.
3293-5412-5531.description:
Cast Lumra by paying {4}{G}{G}.
When Lumra enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 3 until you control no lands.
When you sacrifice the last land, Lumra will die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Resolve the Lumra trigger from step 2, causing you to mill four cards and return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Lumra from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
3293-5412-5531.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

1395-1987-3980-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Sisay's Ring by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn
Resolve Ghostly Flicker, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Sisay's Ring.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a coin counter on it

1349-6798-6863--133.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the Dinosaur in your hand.
1349-6798-6863--133.description:
Cast the Dinosaur in your hand by paying its mana cost. It will enter with a coin counter due to Blue.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Dinosaur.
When the Dinosaur dies, Athreos's second ability triggers, returning the Dinosaur from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will enter with a coin counter due to Blue.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-3490-6600.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2034-3490-6600.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Shelinda triggers, either putting a +1/+1 counter on it or the creature that entered the battlefield.
Animation Module triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

1744-4600-6567.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, creating five token copies of Dragonhawk.
When the Dragonhawk tokens enter the battlefield, they each trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, exiling a number of cards from the top of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining trigger.
At the beginning of your end step, each Dragonhawk token triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent for each card exiled by the Dragonhawk tokens that were not played.
1744-4600-6567.notes: Assuming you control no other creatures with power 4 or greater, this combo can deal up to 60 damage to each opponent. This is reduced by 2 for each card you play that is exiled. For every additional creature you control with power 4 or greater, this combo deals up to an additional 10 damage per creature to each opponent.

64-914-5530.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
64-914-5530.description:
Cast Another Round by paying {2}{W}, blinking Dockside Extortionist and Warden of the Eye.
When Dockside Extortionist and Warden of the Eye enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye trigger, returning Another Round from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.
64-914-5530.notes: If opponents control four or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

483-1116-3240-5670.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
483-1116-3240-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by sacrificing Nether Traitor and paying 1 life.
When Nether Traitor dies, Cruel Celebrant and Sek'Kuar trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Graveborn.
When the Graveborn dies, Cruel Celebrant and Nether Traitor trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Nether Traitor trigger, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

1799-1809-2579-2701-4050.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Returned Pastcaller, adding one mana of any color.
When Returned Pastcaller dies, The Cauldron of Eternity triggers, putting Returned Pastcaller from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Returned Pastcaller from the bottom of your library into your graveyard, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Returned Pastcaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Grenzo's ability any number of times.

575-1207-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken Forest.
575-1207-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a nontoken Forest, which is a creature due to Ambush Commander.
When the Forest dies, Yedora triggers, returning the Forest from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

3946-4011-4426.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

451-3750.notablePrerequisites:
Hoard Hauler is a creature and does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Hoard Hauler and controls at least five artifacts.
451-3750.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent who controls five or more artifacts using Hoard Hauler.
Hoard Hauler triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
If the opponent controls six or more artifacts, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

579-774-2137-4826.notablePrerequisites:
High Tide in hand.You control at least two mana-producing lands.
Archelos is untapped.
579-774-2137-4826.description:
Cast any instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Holding priority, activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands to your hand, copying the instant or sorcery.
Resolve the copy of the instant or sorcery.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting two lands from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat from step 2.

2855-4245.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Vrondiss indestructible.
You have a way to deal damage to Vrondiss.
2855-4245.description:
Give Vrondiss indestructible by any method.
Deal damage to Vrondiss by any method.
Vrondiss triggers, creating a 5/4 Dragon Spirit creature token.
The Dragon Spirit enters the battlefield, triggering Dragon Tempest, causing the Dragon Spirit to deal damage to Vrondiss equal to the number of Dragons you control.
The Dragon Spirit and Vrondiss trigger.
Resolve the Dragon Spirit trigger, causing you to sacrifice it.
Resolve the Vrondiss trigger, creating a 5/4 Dragon Spirit creature token.
Repeat from step 4.

186-3334-4832-5115.notablePrerequisites: Ensoul Artifact attached to Gemstone Array.
186-3334-4832-5115.description:
Activate Gemstone Array's first ability by paying {1}, putting two charge counters on itself.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

238-1703-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Fool's Demise attached to Gerrard.
You control at least five other creatures.
238-1703-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar six times by sacrificing Gerrard and five other creatures, adding {5}{U}.
Gerrard dies, triggering its ability and Fool's Demise's first and second abilities.
Resolve the first Fool's Demise trigger, returning Gerrard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise trigger, returning Fool's Demise from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Gerrard trigger, returning all artifact and creature cards put into your graveyard this turn to the battlefield.
Cast Fool's Demise by paying {4}{U}, attaching it to Gerrard.
Repeat.

4125-4305-4872.notablePrerequisites: Followed Footsteps attached to Shipwreck Dowser.
4125-4305-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Followed Footsteps triggers, creating a token copy of Shipwreck Dowser.
The Shipwreck Dowser token enters the battlefield, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
